items.label: ID Certificates
items.details: Minimum amount charged monthly to keep a certification active. This allows both Certified Solo users and members of Certified Entity organizations to generate advanced e-signatures tied to their wallet.

items.label: Sponsored transactions
items.details: Only the gas actually used is charged when sponsoring transactions, with a multiplier to cover relayer costs, processing fees and price fluctuations. Price is in Euro at currency rates updated every minute, with a minimum of 0.01€.

items.label: Advanced digital signatures
items.details: Certified signatures for legally binding actions included in both Certified Solo and Certified Entity plans.

items.label: Additional IPFS storage (above 1GB)
items.details: IPFS storage above 1GB is charged monthly for both organizations and personal workspaces.
